title: Realtime subscriptions with Amazon EventBridge and AWS AppSync
description: Create real time subscriptions from EventBridge to AppSync

introBox.headline: How it works
text: This pattern configures AppSync as an EventBridge target allowing consumers subscribe to real-time updates using GraphQL subscriptions.
Events published on the event bus are forwared to the Mutation on the AppSync GraphQL schema. Consumers of the API can subscribe in real time.
Using this example GraphQL subscription you can listen for events based on account, region, detail-type or source.
See the GitHub repo for detailed testing instructions.
